S108.09.needs: a Cloud account on a plan that grants Deep research
S108.09.note: No separate financial workspace exists on mobile. The FMP connector is listed only in the web vendor directory, and I did not confirm that the mobile Connectors row shows it. The + button's label is an accessibility label, not visible text.
steps: Sign in and open the Chat tab, in Cloud mode with a model that supports research and search.
Tap the + button (Add to chat) next to Message input.
Look for the Deep research row and switch it on. If the row is missing, the plan or model does not allow it.
Type a financial question, for example about a stock, an ETF or a company's filings, and send.
Open the Reports list from the drawer and open the report.
Compare with Expected: a research answer for markets, instruments or filings, with sources cited.
S108.09.where: Chat > Message input > Add to chat (+) > Deep research; results appear in Reports (drawer)

S108.19.needs: a Cloud account, and a contract file to upload
S108.19.note: The skill is in the repo as review-contract (triage-nda is a related skill). Mobile shows only the skills the Cloud catalog returns, so I did not confirm that this one is listed. Skills can also be picked from Add to chat > Skills.
steps: Open Settings and tap Customize (Cloud section).
Tap Skills and find review-contract, or search for it.
Tap Install, then tap Use in chat.
In the chat, send a contract to review and ask for clauses, risks and redlines against a playbook.
Compare with Expected: clauses are extracted, risks flagged and redlines suggested against a playbook.
S108.19.where: Settings > Customize > Skills > find review-contract > Install > Use in chat
